meta.title: Intuition and Chakras: How to Increase Your Psychic Development Through Energy
meta.author: Lesley Phillips, PhD

parts.title: About the Author and Her Mission

sentences: **Lesley Phillips**, **PhD**, is a **spiritual teacher** passionate about **helping** people tap into their **intuition**.

Having started **intuitive sessions** since 1996 and teaching **meditation, healing,** and **intuition development** since 2003, she aims to **bring intuition** to as many as possible through her **School of Intuition**, **radio show**, **mentoring sessions**, and more.
Formerly an **environmental microbiologist** and **business negotiator**, she believes our **psychic senses** are our **natural communication** tools.
Lesley's work includes her **Psychic Ability Blueprint** and the **Portico Soul Essence Cards**, aiding others to **validate their purpose** and reminding them of their **intuitive potential**.
Her spiritual novel, **The Midas Tree**, nurtures spiritual gifts in both **children** and **adults**.
**Intuition Blueprint** is your unique map of spiritual abilities, allowing you to understand and utilize your gifts.
This map offers insights about how to live your life purpose.
It's crucial for **self-knowledge** and understanding why you may self-sabotage.
Your Blueprint helps you align with your inner guidance and unleash potential previously hidden by doubts or lack of understanding.

Everyone is an **infinite consciousness**, and by embracing your Intuition Blueprint, you can unblock and utilize your intuition to improve everyday life, replace **limiting beliefs**, and grow spiritually.
Chakras and **psychic abilities** connect through your unique Intuition Blueprint, offering guidance in **self-navigation**.
Everyone has distinct abilities linked to chakras, which foster growth and support life goals.
These abilities vary, from clairvoyance to **clairaudience**, and understanding them in context with your chakras helps clear blocks and utilize potential.
This book introduces these relationships, providing a framework in Part Two.
Understanding this harmony cultivates **self-awareness** and empowers you to actively create your future guided by inner wisdom.
**Accept your experiences** as they are without resisting them.
The **law of attraction** involves accepting responsibility for your own creations and being open to **unconscious manifestations**.
The concept of **aura** is an **energy field** surrounding your body, acting as your personal **creative universe**.
It reflects your current state of being, indicating **health** or emotional issues.
Your **intuitive awareness** can help you read and heal your aura, making you a conscious creator of your reality.
**Intuition** is a natural ability that can be accessed **consciously** and developed with practice, such as through **meditation**.

Many people mistakenly believe that **intuition is sporadic** and only happens in sudden flashes, or that it must make **logical sense** when in fact, it is often **subtle** and doesn't always align with our logical mind.
Despite this, intuition is **constantly active**, but external influences might sometimes dominate our attention.
To truly harness intuition, you need to **quiet** these external influences and tune into your **inner world**.
This can be achieved by understanding your unique **intuitive style** and consciously working to **recognize** it when it arises.
Intuition can sometimes be **vague**, but with **practice**, you can learn to access it whenever you want and use it to guide you beyond the confines of logic.
Everyone has **intuition**, regardless of being male or female.
It's part of our spiritual **journey** and can be supportive in various spheres of life.
While some claim **intuition** is only for special individuals, it's a gift accessible to all.
Practicing intuition involves communicating with higher **consciousness**, your soul, and even past lives, angels, and guides.
It's possible to connect with loved ones who have passed, nature, animals, and even **galactic beings**.
The key is focusing on your **intentions** for developing your intuition and **mastering** the abilities.

parts.title: Overcoming Self-Doubt and Exploring Abstract Intuition

sentences: **Christina** faced intense **self-doubt** about her **clairvoyant abilities** despite showing a **gift** in using her **sixth chakra**.
Initially blocked by past invalidations, she needed encouragement to embrace her **inner guidance**.
Over time, by releasing past experiences, Christina gained confidence and now values her abilities, planning to study **energy medicine** to assist others.
**Abstract Intuition** involves understanding **light, symbols, geometry** without relying on the intellect.
This ability can lead to being labeled as gifted or experiencing various unique skills such as musical or mathematical prodigies.
Signs of abstract intuition include a passion for **numbers, music, and art** or seeing the world in unique ways.
**Nikola Tesla** exemplified this with his mental experiments, highlighting the potential of accessing **answers effortlessly**.
Abstract Intuition allows for conveying complex meanings without traditional intellectual processes.

parts.title: Third Chakra - Solar Plexus and Energy Management

sentences: The **third chakra**, or **solar plexus**, connects **physical** and **astral bodies** to help distribute **energy** for our life's purpose.
True **power** comes from owning and channeling energy **authentically** for our unique path.
While many misuse their **energy** by exerting **authority** over others, it's important to live authentically, with **respect** and **boundaries**.
Owning power means saying no to what doesn't align with your soul and standing by your beliefs.
One example is **Nicky**, who reclaimed her **power** after leaving an abusive household.
Misused power can manifest in feeling **manipulated** or like a **victim**.
By redistributing energy wisely, we can align our **free will** with life's goals.
**Out-of-body experiences (OOBE)** allow exploring **consciousness** beyond the physical realm, like **dreams** or even **near-death experiences**.
Managing **third chakra** energy and dreaming awareness can aid in **spiritual growth**.
It's vital to **own** and use your energy for your unique **purpose** in the world.
Intuition involves multiple chakras working together, like mind, body, and spirit.
**Clairsentience** allows you to communicate with your body to identify if emotions belong to you or others, helping manage empathy and energy boundaries.
**Meditation** is key for cultivating intuition and managing clairsentience by **grounding** your chi.
Owning personal space improves experiences and connections.
Listening to your body is crucial—if not, it may react with dis-ease, manifesting negative physical or emotional health outcomes.
**Hyper-vigilance** to emotions around you might depict discomfort from others invading personal space.
Empathic individuals often confuse their own emotions with others, which meditation can clarify.
The **importance of presence** in mastering life purposes, chakras, and intuition is emphasized.
The author uses the **metaphor of a journey** to explain how people are often not fully present in their bodies, similar to traveling from A to B without remembering the trip.
Many individuals escape their current reality to connect with higher spiritual vibrations or to avoid pain.
To **remain present**, it's crucial to focus on the **breath**.
Breathing techniques, such as **square breathing** and **ascending breath**, are suggested to help individuals ground themselves and connect to their physical bodies.
**Explore** your **Intuition Blueprint** by identifying your **experience** and **challenge** in intuition.
Recall and note down past intuition experiences, linking each to relevant **chakras** and **styles**.
Then, review **intuition challenges** related to **life lessons** to understand how overcoming these can reveal your greatest gifts and align with your life purpose.
Document this on **Your Intuition Chart** to visualize areas of strength or where growth is needed.
Even **challenges** or **blocks** reveal **focus areas** for growth in your spiritual journey.
Consider meditation practices from the book for overcoming these blocks, **centering**, and improving your intuition flow.
